body.p: Please amend the specification as follows. Insertions appear as bold underlined text (e.g., insertions) while deletions appear as bold strikethrough text (e.g., deletions).

[0002] The present application is a continuation of U.S. Patent Application No. 18/165,711, filed February 7, 2023, entitled, "MODULAR MULTI-PARAMETER PATIENT MONITORING DEVICE", and issued as U.S. Patent No. 11,969,269, which is a continuation of U.S. Patent Application No. 17/378,556, filed July 16, 2021, entitled "MODULAR MULTI- PARAMETER PATIENT MONITORING DEVICE", and issued as U.S. Patent No. 11,596,365, which is a continuation of U.S. Patent Application No. 16/856,876, filed April 23, 2020, entitled "MODULAR MULTI-PARAMETER PATIENT MONITORING DEVICE", and issued as U.S. Patent No. 11,096,631, which is a continuation of U.S. Patent Application No. 16/409,625, filed May 10, 2019, entitled "MODULAR MULTI-PARAMETER PATIENT MONITORING DEVICE", and issued as U.S. Patent No. 10,667,762, which is a continuation of U.S. Patent Application No. 15/903,526, filed February 23, 2018, entitled "MODULAR MULTI- PARAMETER PATIENT MONITORING DEVICE," and issued as U.S. Patent No. 10,327,713, which claims priority benefit of U.S. Provisional Application No. 62/463297, filed February 24, 2017, titled "MODULAR MULTI-PARAMETER PATIENT MONITORING DEVICE," the entire contents of each of which are incorporated herein by reference in their entirety.
